Ich habe den letzten Zug verpasst und bin zu Fuß nach Hause gegangen.
meaning: I missed the last train and walked home.

text: Kannst du mir bitte das Salz geben?
meaning: Can you pass me the salt, please?

text: Am Wochenende fahren wir in die Berge.
meaning: At the weekend we're going to the mountains.

text: Der Kühlschrank ist schon wieder leer.
meaning: The fridge is empty again.

text: Meine Nachbarin hat drei Katzen und einen Hund.
meaning: My neighbour has three cats and a dog.

text: Wir treffen uns um acht vor dem Kino.
meaning: We'll meet at eight in front of the cinema.

text: Das Hotel hat ein Restaurant und eine Bar.
meaning: The hotel has a restaurant and a bar.

text: Bei Regen bleibe ich lieber im Bett.
meaning: When it rains I'd rather stay in bed.

text: Die Bäckerei an der Ecke öffnet um sechs.
meaning: The bakery on the corner opens at six.

text: Ich verstehe nur Bahnhof.
meaning: Idiom, literally "I only understand train station": I don't understand a thing.

text: Perdí el último tren y volví a casa caminando.
meaning: I missed the last train and walked home.

text: ¿Me pasas la sal, por favor?
meaning: Can you pass me the salt, please?

text: Mañana vamos a la playa si no llueve.
meaning: Tomorrow we're going to the beach if it doesn't rain.

text: Mi abuela todavía escribe cartas a mano.
meaning: My grandmother still writes letters by hand.

text: El perro de mi vecino ladra toda la noche.
meaning: My neighbour's dog barks all night.

text: Nos vemos a las ocho delante del cine.
meaning: See you at eight in front of the cinema.

text: El hotel tiene un restaurante y un bar.
meaning: The hotel has a restaurant and a bar.

text: No hay mal que por bien no venga.
meaning: Proverb: every cloud has a silver lining.

text: La panadería de la esquina abre a las seis.
meaning: The bakery on the corner opens at six.

text: Me gusta cocinar con música.
meaning: I like cooking with music on.
